title: fix(objectql)!: a formula reading another formula reads its computed value; a cycle of formulas is refused where it is authored
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1pr7WKFdwpFyr1r3Yy3buH)_

Fixes #33100

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-formula` teaches no rule about one formula reading another; `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` already said not to create circular references and now says they are refused (updated here).

## 维护者速读
1. 改了什么:公式字段引用另一个公式字段(如 `f_total = record.f_sibling * 2`)时,引擎先算被引用的公式再算引用方,卡片里 2 × 5 的例子读出 20;互相引用或引用自己的公式(循环)读 null,日志点名循环,发布门禁和 `os build` 用同一句话拒收。
2. 为什么改:以前引擎按字段声明顺序(或查询投影顺序)逐个算,引用方排在前面、或查询只点名引用方时就读出 null,而 Studio 编辑器、`validate_expression` 和发布门禁都说合法,数据静默出错。
3. 风险与回滚:读路径只动公式字段的计算顺序和计算范围,非公式字段不变;循环拒收是收窄(BREAKING),已发布的循环公式本来就恒为 null,再次保存会被拒并给出修法。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
4. 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`(`planFormulaProjection` 与新的 `orderFormulaPlan`)、`packages/formula/src/formula-read-order.ts`(排序与循环判定,引擎和门禁共用)、`packages/lint/src/formula-cycle-issues.ts`。
5. 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-formula-dependency-order.test.ts`,预期 7 条全绿(含 20、三级链 10/20/21、循环读 null 并点名)。
6. 需要你做的:无,席位落地(收窄面先经 triage 席契约复审)。

## What changes

- **Runtime, `@objectstack/objectql`** (`engine-top-level.ts`): `planFormulaProjection` hands its plan to a new `orderFormulaPlan`, which (1) adds every formula a planned formula reads, transitively, and (2) orders the plan so each formula is evaluated after the formulas it reads. Reads are named by the member reader the stored-expression plan already uses (`storedExpressionReads`, i.e. `analyzeRelationshipTraversals`). A formula planned only because a named formula reads it joins `widened`, so a projection's answer is cut back to what the caller named; it is never sent to the driver as a column. Every caller of the plan builder gets the fix: `find`, `findOne`, the write response (`hydrateWriteFormulas`), `evaluateFormulaField` and `serveFormulaField`. A plan in which no formula reads another is returned unchanged.
- **Cycles**: a formula that reads its own value, itself or through the formulas it reads, is marked `cycle` on its plan entry; `applyFormulaPlan` writes `null` and reports the sentence naming the cycle to the fault sink, without evaluating it, so nothing loops. A formula off the cycle that reads a member is evaluated over that `null`.
- **Shared answer, `@objectstack/formula`**: `formulaReadOrder(reads)` returns the evaluation order and the cycle members with their sentence (`formulaCycleMessage`). The engine and the lint both take it from here, so the read-time fault and the authoring refusal are the same words.
- **Authoring, `@objectstack/lint`**: the object walk of `validateStackExpressions` refuses each declared formula on a cycle (`formulaCycleIssues`, new `formula-cycle-issues.ts`), severity `error`, located at `object 'X' · field 'F' expression` like the field-formula pass. This is the rule the object save and publish door runs and `os build` / `os validate` run. Formulas reading formulas without a cycle are not refused.
- Ledger: ADR-0087 semantic entry `formula-cycle-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.formula-cycle-refused.ts`), so `objectstack migrate meta` and the upgrade guide name the refusal (a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` changeset cannot take `not-required`).
- Docs: the circular-reference bullet in `formulas.mdx`. Changeset: `minor` for `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/spec` (Metadata-protocol `narrowed`), BREAKING banner, `adr-0087: registered formula-cycle-refused`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-dependency-order.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL`, in-memory driver double copied from `engine-formula-fault-log.test.ts`): the card's 2 × 5 case reads 20 on the write response, `find` and `findOne` with the reader declared last and first; a projection naming only `f_total` answers `[{ f_total: 20 }]`; `evaluateFormulaField` and `serveFormulaField` read 20 and do not write the record handed in; a chain of three declared last-reader-first reads 10/20/21, and a projection of `quantity, f_c` answers exactly those; a self-reference and a mutual pair read `null` with one fault each equal to `formulaCycleMessage`, a reader of the cycle reads `-1` (its null guard) with no fault, an unrelated formula reads 6.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts` (through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, the door's entry): the card's object passes in either order, a chain of three passes, a self-reference and a mutual pair are refused on each member with the engine's sentence, a reader of the pair is not refused, and the build's finding equals the door's.
- `packages/formula/src/formula-read-order.test.ts`: order, ignored non-formula reads, cycle members of length 1 and 3.

Ablation (each with the fix committed, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty; both suites import the mutated file from `src/`, so no rebuild is involved):
- runtime, `const ordered = orderFormulaPlan(plan, schema.fields);` replaced by the pre-fix plan: `Tests  6 failed | 1 passed (7)`; the one that stays green is the reader-declared-last read, which main already served.
- gate, the `formulaCycleIssues` call in `validate-expressions.ts` disabled (`objectName && false`): `Tests  3 failed | 2 passed (5)`; the two that stay green are the acceptance pins.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-measured on main `5430b4a4` with the card's object on a real `ObjectQL`: declared sibling-first with no projection, `f_total` already read 20; declared reader-first, or any projection naming `f_total` without `f_sibling`, read `null` with `No such key: f_sibling`. QA's REST read met one of those two shapes.
- `validate_expression` is unchanged. It is handed an expression and an object, not the field the expression belongs to, so it cannot see a cycle; its disagreement with the gate is #32872, not carried here. The Studio editor still flags only a self-reference client-side; a mutual pair is refused at save/publish by the door with a located message.
- A cycle made only of fields an `objectExtensions` entry adds is not refused by this pass (findings are located on the object's declared fields); the runtime still reads `null` with the cycle sentence for it.
- Read-only observation, not filed: the stored computed-field write plan (`planStoredExpressions`, a non-formula field with an `expression`) is evaluated in declaration order too, so a stored expression reading another stored expression declared after it would read that field's previous stored value. Not measured; not this card's surface.
- 18.4.0: the version PR merged and the thaw is not posted; this PR is not enqueued, the seat lands it.

## Verification

Head `10b05e871` (origin/main `5430b4a4`; main had not moved, so no merge commit). Every exit captured before any pipe.

- Whole-tree `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` under the verify lock on `10b05e871`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` on `10b05e871`: `Test Files  840 passed (840)`, `Tests  26824 passed | 1 todo (26825)`.
- On `b13bba1f3` (the head before the ledger entry, which adds only `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.formula-cycle-refused.ts` and the changeset's spec line): `@objectstack/formula` `Tests  1755 passed (1755)`; `@objectstack/lint` `Tests  8620 passed (8620)`; `@objectstack/objectql` `Tests  12791 passed (12791)`; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `Tests  22799 passed | 36 skipped (22835)`; `typecheck` of formula, lint and objectql: exit 0.
- New pins: `engine-formula-dependency-order.test.ts` 7/7, `runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts` 5/5, `formula-read-order.test.ts` 3/3.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates, lint and dogfood</summary>

Running at PR open on `10b05e871`: the 115 families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives, then `pnpm lint`, then the full dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm). A first pass on `b13bba1f3` reached 56 families with one red, `check-adr-0087-registration` (a `narrowed` changeset cannot take `not-required`), which `10b05e871` fixes (exit 0 there). The `--ran` reconciliation and the battery's counts are in the os-dev report on #33100 and the seat applies them here.
</details>
